claim: Climate change and global warming is a serious concern.
key_findings: Class weighting improved Macro-F1 for all three architectures on Hindi/Bengali validation.
Weighted XLM-RoBERTa achieved the highest validation Macro-F1.
Standard XLM-RoBERTa performed worse on the independent English test set than on Hindi/Bengali validation.
The English model failed to predict any Against examples.
English errors included missed climate denial and indirect expressions of concern.
limitations: Small and imbalanced Hindi/Bengali validation dataset.
English test comments were collected from a single YouTube video.
English labels are not yet verified three-annotator consensus.
Hindi/Bengali validation and English test datasets differ in composition.
Weighted XLM-RoBERTa was not evaluated on the English test set.
